instruction: A warm lifestyle portrait photograph, close-up shot at eye-level, set against a solid dusty pink studio backdrop. In the foreground, the curly-haired woman in the white shirt (R1) faces forward, smiling broadly at the camera. Behind her, the straight-haired woman in the denim jacket (R2) leans her arm and chin affectionately on R1's shoulder, also smiling towards the camera. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting, creating a warm, friendly atmosphere with minimal shadows.
